notes:
What's new in 0.1.123:
- Backup: one unreadable safety copy no longer empties the whole list of safety copies (clean-up still deletes nothing while any copy cannot be read), a restore no longer says a part was not running when it really failed, and the Live TV guide notice appears only when it applies. Photo backup can resume a big video when the rest of the batch fits, no longer says Up to date too early, handles files with no extension, and follows the battery rule.
- Remote Desktop: Start sharing works again on the current Electron, and the sharing window now opens in front instead of behind other windows.
- Sharing with another household: when you press Stop sharing, posters and artwork stop for the guest at once, and guests only get a short private cache of them.
- Library and search: names with several episodes or dates in them, owner-picked shows, TV years and non-Latin names are read better, a TV show whose own folder is called Extras, Samples or Trailers is now listed, and the computer file search ignores accents. Import now matches non-Latin file names, copes with missing library folders and with .nfo files that are not UTF-8.
- Watching in the browser: the player saves the exact spot when a seek lands and when the page is hidden, Continue Watching and Up next skip other copies of an episode you have finished, and playlists, subtitles (a tag-only line no longer ends a cue) and Watch Together (clean room close, rejoin after a short drop, pasted codes, missed notices) have several smaller fixes.
- Music, books and podcasts: lyrics always end in lyrics, No lyrics or a Retry button, radio asks for more songs at the end, artist Play and Shuffle follow album order, MP3 chapter times and the front cover are read, podcast chapters work offline, Continue listening shows each audiobook once, and the mix cards are translated.
- Photos and the converter: photos show upright on any FFmpeg, you are told about the file cap, zoom and paging in the photo viewer are steadier, and the converter never hangs its queue after a failed save and checks that a job fits on the disk first.
- Connection and devices: a stuck port test, the Remote list status and a raw address error are fixed, and the diagnostics report you copy now hides IP addresses and your Beebo name. The Jellyfin API sorts episodes and seasons properly and returns the right Next Up episode.
- Looks and words: light themes have a readable skip link, visible focus rings and readable Theater cards; the Admin screen shows plain error text; genre names follow the interface language; the Get Started connection test offers Try again; German texts use the formal Sie; counts say 1 song and 1 show (not 1 songs); Users page button names start with the visible words in six languages.
- Server changes that are NOT in this installer: the game-room (Beebo Play) sign-in token now keeps the old one until the new one is confirmed, and several service and walkie-talkie fixes. They go live with a server update, not with this download.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.122 was published on November 16, 2026. The Keep me signed in option is not in this build.
